entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The royal convoy finally arrived at..."
entries.dialogueText: The royal convoy finally arrived at the entrance to the Alliance of Nations Headquarters in Konstantium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After the usual greetings, Laurento..."
entries.dialogueText: After the usual greetings, Laurento and I settled at our table in the conference hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked around the foyer. Of all t..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked around the foyer. Of all the leaders gathered here, we'd made the most grandiose entrance by far. I felt good about today.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Here we go, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Here we go, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He leaned over and whispered in my..."
entries.dialogueText: He leaned over and whispered in my ear.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's the worst thing that can ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's the worst thing that can happen?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am confident in this session.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am confident in this session."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We will see.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will see."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""These sessions bore me to death.""
entries.dialogueText: "These sessions bore me to death."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It should be over in a heartbeat.""
entries.dialogueText: "It should be over in a heartbeat."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Let's see.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's see."

entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""Very well. On to the first item on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. On to the first item on the agenda."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A man that I recognized as Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: A man that I recognized as President Nines approached the podium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Prime Minister Saltana turned to fa..."
entries.dialogueText: Prime Minister Saltana turned to face me head-on as I approached her.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Your Majesty. So nice to see you h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. So nice to see you here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, so *now* it's 'Your Majesty'.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, so *now* it's 'Your Majesty'."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough small talk. I know all abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough small talk. I know all about your sabotage plans."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You too, Madam Prime Minister. Des..."
entries.dialogueText: "You too, Madam Prime Minister. Despite the circumstances."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've got some nerve, showing you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've got some nerve, showing your face in these chambers after what you did."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Our plans?""
entries.dialogueText: "Our plans?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Morella didn't plan anything. Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella didn't plan anything. Your own people were the ones attempting to take the Rizian energy grid into their own hands."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""What circumstances?""
entries.dialogueText: "What circumstances?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Titles are important to you Rizian..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titles are important to you Rizians, aren't they?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""What I did...?""
entries.dialogueText: "What I did...?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I'm sorry, but the session's just..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, but the session's just about to start. We'll talk another time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll talk now. Or I'll reveal you..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll talk now. Or I'll reveal your plans to sabotage our energy infrastructure to this entire assembly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can't fool me. Pretending to b..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't fool me. Pretending to be Little Miss Do-Gooder while plotting to blow up our pipelines..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please, Ms. Saltana. I'm giving yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Ms. Saltana. I'm giving you a chance to explain yourself. You may not get another."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you wouldn't mind if I revealed..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you wouldn't mind if I revealed your involvement to everyone at the Alliance of Nations?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They never would have done such a..."
entries.dialogueText: "They never would have done such a thing on their own. You and your CSP partners drove them to it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Cut the bullshit. We have concrete..."
entries.dialogueText: "Cut the bullshit. We have concrete proof of your involvement."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She exhaled impatiently."
entries.dialogueText: She exhaled impatiently.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""No harm has been done. And I'm wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "No harm has been done. And I'm willing to listen to whatever it is you want."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "That is, until I realized that none..."
entries.dialogueText: That is, until I realized that none of the various delegations I passed were making eye contact with me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento caught up to me with quick..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento caught up to me with quick steps. His words came in a worried whisper.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I've just spoken to an old friend..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've just spoken to an old friend of mine. Deivid Wisci, the Sordish foreign minister."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Despite the deteriorating relation..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the deteriorating relations between our countries, he was willing to divulge that Lespia is planning on proposing sanctions on Rizia at today's session."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Despite the deteriorating relation..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the deteriorating relations between our countries, he was willing to divulge that Valgsland is planning on proposing sanctions on Rizia at today's session."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He confided that Lespia is plannin..."
entries.dialogueText: "He confided that Lespia is planning on proposing sanctions on Rizia at today's session."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He confided that Valgsland is plan..."
entries.dialogueText: "He confided that Valgsland is planning on proposing sanctions on Rizia at today's session."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How dare Alvarez pull a stunt like..."
entries.dialogueText: "How dare Alvarez pull a stunt like this after what Lespia did to us?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How dare Hegel pull a stunt like t..."
entries.dialogueText: "How dare Hegel pull a stunt like this after what his Morellan minions did to us?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And you're sure this Deivid is a t..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you're sure this Deivid is a trustworthy source?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, I can't say I'm surprised to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I can't say I'm surprised to hear that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What? The other member states will..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? The other member states will never go along with it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What? The other member states will..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? The other member states will never go along with it."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The man doesn't have a dishonest b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The man doesn't have a dishonest bone in his body."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento caught up to me with quick..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento caught up to me with quick steps. I had to strain to hear his words.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Rusty came through, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "Rusty came through, Your Majesty. The documents he provided indeed implicate Lespia in the Friendship Day incident."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But I don't know what you intend t..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I don't know what you intend to do with this evidence. After all, you and Prime Minister Alvarez agreed that Lespia's involvement would be kept secret."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""If this comes to light, the other..."
entries.dialogueText: "If this comes to light, the other AN states will never agree to Smolak's referendum."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But I'm not sure what good this in..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I'm not sure what good this information does now. You've already managed to negotiate Zille's safe return, after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I said I'd destroy the evidence ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I said I'd destroy the evidence our investigation had turned up. I never agreed to keep Lespia's involvement a secret."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lespia must be held accountable fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia must be held accountable for its crimes. It's time to shame Prime Minister Alvarez on a global stage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For now. Who knows what Smolak wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "For now. Who knows what Smolak will try to pull at the last minute?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I haven't decided what to do yet...."
entries.dialogueText: "I haven't decided what to do yet. But it's a useful piece of leverage to have."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is it. Zille will be ours aga..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is it. Zille will be ours again."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A voice over the loudspeaker announ..."
entries.dialogueText: A voice over the loudspeaker announced that it was time to take our seats.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""If these sanctions go through, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "If these sanctions go through, they have the potential to severely damage our economy and our foreign standing."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I should hope not.""
entries.dialogueText: "I should hope not."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I should hope not.""
entries.dialogueText: "I should hope not."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I'm surprised as well.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm surprised as well."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I'm surprised as well.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm surprised as well."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But we do have one useful piece of..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we do have one useful piece of leverage. Rusty came through with his evidence. We now possess conclusive proof that Lespia organized the Friendship Day bombing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wow. I didn't think Rusty had it i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wow. I didn't think Rusty had it in him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perfect. It's time to shame Alvare..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perfect. It's time to shame Alvarez on a global stage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We can use it to stop the sanction..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can use it to stop the sanctions and get back Zille at the same time. Two victories for the price of one."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""At the expense of our relations wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the expense of our relations with Lespia. But those were never going to recover, I fear."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He didn't get to where he is by be..."
entries.dialogueText: "He didn't get to where he is by being bad at subterfuge."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I must admit he deserves it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I must admit he deserves it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't know what good that'll do.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know what good that'll do."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""At the very least, it will make Le..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the very least, it will make Lespia look hypocritical for accusing us of wrongdoing."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But not everyone in this hall will..."
entries.dialogueText: "But not everyone in this hall will be on our accuser's side. I'm sure of that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sharply banged his gavel to begi..."
entries.dialogueText: He sharply banged his gavel to begin the session.

entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""Good morning. I hereby open this s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good morning. I hereby open this session of the Alliance of Nations."

entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""Today's agenda includes a proposal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today's agenda includes a proposal of sanctions on the Kingdom of Rizia, a vote regarding the disputed territory of Heljiland, and a discussion on the region of Zille."

entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""I additionally invite all member s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I additionally invite all member states to share any other urgent matters you believe deserve our collective attention."

entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""Today's agenda includes a proposal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today's agenda includes a proposal of sanctions on the Kingdom of Rizia and a vote regarding the disputed territory of Heljiland."

entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""Today's agenda includes a vote reg..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today's agenda includes a vote regarding the disputed territory of Heljiland and a discussion on the region of Zille."

entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""Today's agenda includes a vote reg..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today's agenda includes a vote regarding the disputed territory of Heljiland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Kingdom of Rizia would like to..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom of Rizia would like to draw this assembly's attention to the crimes perpetrated by the Republic of Lespia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't say anything."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't say anything.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One of my aides approached Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: One of my aides approached President Nines' podium with the evidence Rusty had given us. Gasps and animated chatter filled the chamber.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I submit to you all conclusive pro..."
entries.dialogueText: "I submit to you all conclusive proof that Lespia organized the Friendship Day incident of 1951."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""An anonymous source bravely disclo..."
entries.dialogueText: "An anonymous source bravely disclosed to us that Lespia has secretly been attempting to sow discord between Rizia and Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Patricio Alvarez tried to buy my s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Patricio Alvarez tried to buy my silence. But I hold in my hands the truth about his misdeeds."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Prime Minister Alvarez will point..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Alvarez will point the finger at Rizia today. He is only trying to divert the blame from his government's attempts to sabotage our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have evidence that Lespia and it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have evidence that Lespia and its backers in ATO actively worked to destabilize us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked across the room at Alvarez..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked across the room at Alvarez. His face was white with rage, but he said nothing.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fortunately, Rizia and Wehlen were..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, Rizia and Wehlen were able to see through the lies and reconcile our differences. Nonetheless, our would-be saboteurs must be held to account."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We hope that the members of this a..."
entries.dialogueText: "We hope that the members of this assembly will keep this information in mind as the session continues."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This blatant meddling is proof of..."
entries.dialogueText: "This blatant meddling is proof of the deep contempt the Arcasian Treaty Organization holds for the countries of South Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lespia's act of terrorism killed c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia's act of terrorism killed civilians and directly impeded the return of the Zille region. They must be held to account."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our neighbors to the north are jea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our neighbors to the north are jealous of our resources and our great monarchy. But we will not let them tear us down."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That will be all.""
entries.dialogueText: "That will be all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now, let the session begin.""
entries.dialogueText: "Now, let the session begin."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May justice prevail today.""
entries.dialogueText: "May justice prevail today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you and God bless Rizia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you and God bless Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A stunned silence settled around th..."
entries.dialogueText: A stunned silence settled around the chamber as my words sunk in.

entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""Thank you, King Romus. The Allianc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, King Romus. The Alliance of Nations acknowledges the evidence submitted by the Kingdom of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""Now, on to the agenda...""
entries.dialogueText: "Now, on to the agenda..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobody spoke."
entries.dialogueText: Nobody spoke.

entries.speaker: Dwight Walker (R)
entries.title: Dwight Walker (R): ""Let the record show Arcasia had no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let the record show Arcasia had no knowledge of Lespia's actions."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A voice came from the back row."
entries.dialogueText: A voice came from the back row.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I highly doubt that, President Wal..."
entries.dialogueText: "I highly doubt that, President Walker."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then I hope you discipline your me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I hope you discipline your member state accordingly. No nation must be allowed to act outside the law."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the same time, I noticed Prime M..."
entries.dialogueText: At the same time, I noticed Prime Minister Alma Saltana trying to walk past me unnoticed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, shall we go inside?""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, shall we go inside?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I suppose we had better.""
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose we had better."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You go on ahead. I just need a qui..."
entries.dialogueText: "You go on ahead. I just need a quick word with Madam Prime Minister over there.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""As you wish, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Looking forward to hearing what th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looking forward to hearing what the little snake has to say for herself."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed and walked into the chambe..."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed and walked into the chamber.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She exhaled impatiently."
entries.dialogueText: She exhaled impatiently.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""There's nothing to explain. Your o..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's nothing to explain. Your own people were the ones attempting to take the Rizian energy grid into their own hands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't try to lie to me. You threat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't try to lie to me. You threatened me with exactly this scenario when I didn't go along with your nationalization plans."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gritted her teeth. It was a mom..."
entries.dialogueText: She gritted her teeth. It was a moment before she spoke.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""There's no need to involve anyone..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's no need to involve anyone else."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not only that. You will vote in Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not only that. You will vote in Rizia's best interests today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And you'll convince your friend He..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you'll convince your friend Hegel not to threaten us with sanctions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. As long as your agents..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. As long as your agents never touch Rizian soil again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will decide what's best for my k..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will decide what's best for my kingdom's workers. Not you. Do not forget that."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It's too late for that. But I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's too late for that. But I will vote in your favor, despite fully agreeing with the Chancellor."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""If you insist.""
entries.dialogueText: "If you insist."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""They won't. If there's a revolutio..."
entries.dialogueText: "They won't. If there's a revolution in your country, it will be 100 percent homegrown."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Then I entreat you to make the rig..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I entreat you to make the right decisions. Before it's too late."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Thank you for your understanding,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your understanding, Your Majesty. I'll be taking my seat now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't try to pull anything.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't try to pull anything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have a nice day, Madam Prime Minis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have a nice day, Madam Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""See you in there.""
entries.dialogueText: "See you in there."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We parted ways and went to take our..."
entries.dialogueText: We parted ways and went to take our respective seats.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After the usual greetings, I settle..."
entries.dialogueText: After the usual greetings, I settled next to Laurento at our table in the conference hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the same time, I noticed Prime M..."
entries.dialogueText: At the same time, I noticed Prime Minister Alma Saltana standing nearby, trying to get my attention.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You go on ahead. I need a quick wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You go on ahead. I need a quick word with Madam Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, of course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed and walked into the chambe..."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed and walked into the chamber.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana turned to face me head-on a..."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana turned to face me head-on as I approached her.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Changed your mind about my marriag..."
entries.dialogueText: "Changed your mind about my marriage offer?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She rolled her eyes."
entries.dialogueText: She rolled her eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's good to see you again, Ms. Sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's good to see you again, Ms. Saltana."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Likewise, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToP..."
entries.dialogueText: "Likewise, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope I can count on you to vote..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope I can count on you to vote in Rizia's favor today."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""You have Morella's support, {Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have Morella's support, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}. But that's not why I want to talk to you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How are you?""
entries.dialogueText: "How are you?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Very busy. But there's something y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very busy. But there's something you should be aware of."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She handed me a sheet of paper. On..."
entries.dialogueText: She handed me a sheet of paper. On it was a list of names and addresses.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I'll make this quick. Connections..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll make this quick. Connections of mine have revealed a potential sabotage plot by revolutionaries in your country."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""They appear to be targeting your e..."
entries.dialogueText: "They appear to be targeting your energy infrastructure. If they succeed, it'd be ruinous for our energy agreement."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""They appear to be targeting your e..."
entries.dialogueText: "They appear to be targeting your energy infrastructure."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I trust you to use this wisely.""
entries.dialogueText: "I trust you to use this wisely."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll see to it that every individu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll see to it that every individual on this list is punished to the full extent of the law."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I value our agreement as much as y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I value our agreement as much as you do. We'll take quick action to prevent disaster."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your 'connections' revealed this p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your 'connections' revealed this plot? Was Morella in on it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, this is embarrassing. Why di..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, this is embarrassing. Why didn't Rizian intelligence get wind of it?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Some of the more extreme left-wing..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some of the more extreme left-wingers in my coalition have had contact with Rizian anti-monarchists."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""A good question. I hope you'll be..."
entries.dialogueText: "A good question. I hope you'll be more attuned to this movement going forward."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""What are allies for?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are allies for?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled wryly."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled wryly.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I'm looking forward to hearing mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm looking forward to hearing more about this inter-Merkopan alliance you're proposing. But I have to say I'm troubled that a portion of your society feels they have to resort to desperate measures to be heard."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I have to say I'm troubled that a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have to say I'm troubled that a portion of your society feels they have to resort to desperate measures to be heard."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Just be careful. You wouldn't want..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just be careful. You wouldn't want to spark a backlash."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I wouldn't expect anything less.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't expect anything less."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""These are rogue dissidents. They d..."
entries.dialogueText: "These are rogue dissidents. They don't represent the opinion of the entire working class."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't have to worry. I am list..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't have to worry. I am listening to their demands for reform and I'm planning to act."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hear them just fine. But they ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hear them just fine. But they are demanding too much."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Very intriguing. I hope you'll kee..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very intriguing. I hope you'll keep us informed."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Can your Adarfo Sotelato confirm t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can your Adarfo Sotelato confirm that?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You really don't need to concern y..."
entries.dialogueText: "You really don't need to concern yourself with the political situation in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Apparently I do. Or would you pref..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apparently I do. Or would you prefer your pipelines exploded?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It doesn't seem like too much to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't seem like too much to me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The loudspeaker voice repeated the..."
entries.dialogueText: The loudspeaker voice repeated the announcement. Saltana turned towards the conference hall doors.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I'll be taking my seat now. See yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be taking my seat now. See you in there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks again.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have a nice day, Madam Prime Minis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have a nice day, Madam Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't forget to vote the right way.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't forget to vote the right way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""First things first. You are to exp..."
entries.dialogueText: "First things first. You are to expedite our MITZ shipments from this point onward. No more obstruction."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She nodded."
entries.dialogueText: She nodded.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""First things first. You are to hon..."
entries.dialogueText: "First things first. You are to honor our MITZ agreement. No matter if Rizia doesn't hold up our end of the bargain."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Call off the MITZ talks. We're goi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Call off the MITZ talks. We're going back to the way things were."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It's too late to call them off com..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's too late to call them off completely. But if Rizia insists on the status quo, I will not get in your way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Adarfo Sotelato. Is he one of your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Adarfo Sotelato. Is he one of yours?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""No, of course not.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, of course not."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""But in the case that any of his su..."
entries.dialogueText: "But in the case that any of his supporters have links to Morella... they will cease being a problem from now on."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How many of your people are embedd..."
entries.dialogueText: "How many of your people are embedded in the RPP?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Officially, none.""
entries.dialogueText: "Officially, none."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""But in the case that any of the pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "But in the case that any of the party's supporters have links to Morella... they will cease being a problem from now on."
